{{Infobox 4on4team |name=Impulse 9 |team=I9 |image=Infobox placeholder.png |color1= |color2= |flag=us |created=1996 |status=Inactive |sponsor= |earnings= |founder={{player|Dr. Rigormortis|flag=us}} |manager= |captain= |irc-channel= |website= }} '''Impulse 9''' was one of the first known gaming teams (clans) in eSports history. Impulse 9 was a team comprised of students from the University of Kansas. == History == "It started in January of '96, pre-Quake, when Spleenripper and I, in anticipation of Quake, got our systems and hooked up a LAN; we built them specifically with Quake in mind," says Dr. Rigormortis. "Qtest came out in, what, mid-March? And we initially only had 3 machines on our LAN... but everyone at the I9 bunker (Me, Spleenripper, Entropy, KillCreek, Smirnov, Ratmonkey, Bad-Ass-Mofo, and Hellkitty) initially took turns fighting in LAN games... Soon everyone was getting their own systems and well before Quake came out we were spending six to eight hours playing...."
- Dr.Rigormortis And from this core of talented game-players came legendary, Impulse 9. The team would achieve fame when one of their players Tom [[Entropy]] Kimzey made it into the grand final of the 1997 [[Red Annihilation]] Tournament. Entropy would face off against Dennis [[Thresh]] Fong where Entropy was smashed in a 14-1 defeat to Fong. Entropy's representation for Impulse 9 and his runner-up position meant it was the first known achievement for an online gaming team. == Members == '''Former members''' * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[Dr. Rigormortis]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[Spleenripper]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[Entropy]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[KillCreek]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[Smirnov]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[Ratmonkey]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[Bad-Ass-Mofo]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[Hellkitty]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[BiAtch]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[GateKeepr]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[rix]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[PVP]] == Achievements == {{AchievementStripped table/intro}} {{AchievementStripped|year=1996|place=3|event=Elite 8|additional=ClanRing|prize=}} {{AchievementStripped|year=1996|place=1|event=ClanRing Tournament 1|additional=Online|prize=}} {{AchievementStripped table/outro}} == External links == [https://www.muppetclan.com/history/ muppetclan.com/history] {{clan-stub}} [[Category:Clans]] [[Category:American Clans]] __NOTOC__
